# BrainBoxWorld

> BrainBoxWorld is a digital marketing and SEO agency that builds high-performance websites, AI systems, automation, and growth-focused digital experiences for ambitious brands worldwide. We serve clients from Nigeria, the United Kingdom, and the United States, and work remotely with businesses in every region.

## About

BrainBoxWorld helps businesses rank on the first page of Google, grow qualified organic traffic, and convert that traffic into revenue. We combine SEO, custom web development, AI, automation, and paid media into a single growth system.

- Founded and led by Adam Bawa Aliyu.
- 8+ years of experience across SEO, web development and growth marketing.
- Global remote team, available 24/7.
- Contact: hellobrainboxworld@gmail.com, info@brainboxworld.dedyn.io, +1 (331) 278-2900.
- Ecosystem: BrainBoxWorld Nigeria (Africa), BrainBoxWorld UK (Europe), VANTIQ Creative (USA).

## Services

- Search Engine Optimization (SEO) — technical SEO, on-page SEO, content SEO, link building, local SEO, ecommerce SEO, international SEO.
- Web design and custom web development — Next.js, TanStack, React, Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Framer.
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and landing page design.
- Paid media — Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads.
- Content marketing and content management.
- Branding, identity and creative direction.
- AI systems — custom GPTs, RAG assistants, AI product videos, AI commercials, AI social content.
- Automation — Zapier, Make, n8n, custom workflows, CRM automation, lead routing.
- Analytics, tracking and reporting — GA4, GTM, server-side tracking, dashboards.

## Industries we serve

Ecommerce, SaaS, professional services, real estate, fintech, education, healthcare, hospitality, creators and personal brands.
